thread_text:
vikram: Heads up—partner infra wants a temporary per-key lift for their ETL workers tomorrow. asking if we can do a timeboxed override with audit entries + auto-revoke. thoughts?

katie: we can, but need RBAC + approval path. is this for production keys or partner sandbox?

vikram: production keys. partner is running a one-off migration that will spike requests for ~6 hours. they asked for a burst cap increase from 2k qps -> 10k qps during window.

dave: +1 for timeboxed override. must include: requester, approver, reason, start/end times, and webhook audit hook. also metric deltas tracked per-key (qps, 429s, latency).

aj: we should enforce a circuit-breaker if error rate > 5% or sustained 429s. overrides shouldn't bypass safety circuits.

carla: agree. console UX: a simple modal that creates an "override request" which hits /internal/keys/{key}/overrides and populates a pending approvals queue. Approver can "approve" or "reject" and we record approver id.

vikram: nice. what about visibility for SRE on-call? need alerts if override causes backend saturation.

katie: add an automatic Canary policy: start at 2x baseline for 10m, then jump to full if metrics are stable. configurable per override.

dave: API example for ops scripts:
```
POST /internal/keys/abcd1234/overrides
{
  "requested_by": "partner-eng",
  "increase_to_qps": 10000,
  "start": "2024-03-13T22:00:00Z",
  "end": "2024-03-14T04:00:00Z",
  "reason": "ETL migration"
}
```
Response should include override_id and status "pending_approval".

vikram: who signs off? product or partnerships? we need a policy for internal vs external partners.

aj: recommend: partnership PM + eng-platform on-call for high-risk. low-risk (<=3x baseline and <=1 hour) can be auto-approved for internal teams.

carla: console should surface historical overrides per-key with filters by date, approver, and outcome. also export CSV for audit.

katie: telemetry: tag metrics with override_id so we can attribute cost and regressions. add a regression alert if token cost / output quality deviates >10%.

dave: implement RBAC roles: override_requester, override_approver, override_admin. default only certain service accounts have requester role for partners.

vikram: logistics: I'll open a short RFC with the API contract and console mockup. can someone own the on-call integration?

aj: i can take on-call alert wiring. will add a runbook snippet.

carla: i'll prototype the modal and wire it to the pending queue API.

eng-bot: created ticket INF-2417 "Partner key override flow + audit" assigned to vikram, carla, aj. due 2024-03-20.

ops-bot: reminder — any override that increases qps > 5k requires a staging smoke test and SRE sign-off before activation.

vikram: perfect. i'll paste the RFC link here once ready. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
